item.description:
Release v5.13.1

Changes since v5.13.0

  • docs(WebServerPlugin): add README and .gitignore
  • feat(AppIconDesigner): add activateViewContainer action to prompt suggestions
  • feat(FactoryCore): add WebRequestToast overlay for web-driven actions
  • feat(FactoryLumi): register PrototypeDesignerPlugin in plugin catalog
  • feat(FactoryLumi): register WebServerPlugin in plugin catalog
  • feat(FactoryLumi): register WhiteNoisePlugin in plugin catalog
  • feat(KernelLumi): add WebRequestActivity event for web request feedback
  • feat(KernelLumi): web route collection, plugin control protocol, and prompt action support
  • feat(LumiPlugin): add webRoutes contribution and clarify promptSuggestions contract
  • feat(MessageListPlugin): prompt suggestions tap-to-send with plugin auto-enable
  • feat(MindMapPlugin): native SwiftUI mind map editor with agent tools
  • feat(PluginManagerPlugin): extract PluginController service for kernel.pluginControl
  • feat(PrototypeDesignerPlugin): LLM-powered prototype designer with live preview
  • feat(ThemeManagerPlugin): expose theme list and select HTTP routes
  • feat(WebServerKit): add GET /api/plugins self-describing endpoint
  • feat(WebServerKit): add local-only web server package
  • feat(WebServerKit): add onActivity callback after route handling
  • feat(WebServerPlugin): add loopback HTTP server plugin
  • feat(WebServerPlugin): wire onActivity to EventManager for toast feedback
  • feat(WhiteNoisePlugin): real-time white/pink/brown noise generator
